answer: Make each agent's payout a concave function — the square root — of its cumulative peer-verified work. One honest node mining a steady plume of checkable tasks earns far more than the same effort split across a hundred shell identities, since ten units on one account beat one unit on ten. Sybils flooding the ocean with clones hit sharp diminishing returns, while the protocol kernel rule reward proportional to sqrt(verified_work) quietly taxes fragmentation and rewards concentrated, auditable honesty.
